title: Routine transfer to savings
story: The wallet sends 0.025 SOL to its own savings account, as it has four times before.

review.reason: Valid by code and consistent with history.

title: Valid by code, 9 SOL to a fresh address
story: The same program, the same signature, 9 SOL: 360x the usual amount, to an address this wallet has never paid.

review.reason: 400x the usual amount to a destination never seen before. Valid by code, but a sensible operator would stop it.

title: The wallet did not sign
story: The program asks the System Program to move the wallet's lamports, but the wallet is not a signer. The runtime refuses before any judgement.

review.reason: The program itself rejected this (error). The judge never overrides a code-level rejection.
